NinjaOne unifies IT operations through endpoint management, patching, backup, and remote access solutions for customers worldwide. The C++ Software Engineer will join the Endpoint State and Control team to build testing infrastructure, expand test coverage, and contribute to systems-level feature development for endpoint security and control projects.

Responsibilities
Testing Ownership: You will begin by building and owning the testing infrastructure and test coverage for two systems, both active C++ development projects
Feature Development: With your strong C++ fundamentals, a genuine interest in systems-level software, being curious in a domain where many answers don’t yet exist, you will begin to take on feature development contributions for our development projects
Other Duties as needed

Required
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical field
1–3 years of C++ experience
Solid C++ fundamentals: memory management, RAII, STL, smart pointers, build systems (CMake preferred)
Interest in systems-level software: OS APIs, processes, file systems, services — understanding what software "beneath the app" does
Experience writing or maintaining automated tests in C++ (Google Test, Catch2, CTest, or equivalent)
Comfortable asking questions and working in an environment where some answers are still being discovered
Comfortable adapting workflows to incorporate AI tools
Strong learning orientation - ability to ramp on new systems, APIs, and patterns through documentation, code reading, and mentorship
Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, *IL, KS, MA, MD, ME, NJ, NC, NY, OR, TN, TX, VA, and WA
This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship
*Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate
Preferred
Any Windows systems programming exposure: Windows APIs, WINAPI, WinBase, Registry access, process management - even if self-taught or project-based
Familiarity with CMake + vcpkg build environments
Experience with test frameworks that support mocking or dependency injection (Google Mock, etc.)
Any exposure to cross-platform C++ (code that compiles on Windows AND macOS or Linux)
Background in or genuine interest in security software (endpoint protection, antivirus, system hardening)
Exposure to ctest or structured CI test pipelines
Benefits
Full-time work that is hybrid remote.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) plan.
Unlimited PTO.
Opportunity for growth and advancement.
Life insurance coverage.
